title: רב חנא בר ביזנא

paragraphs: Rav Chana bar Bizna: “R. Shimon the Pious said”—Berakhot 43b; Rosh Hashanah 18b; Yoma 77a. Ein Yaakov has Chama bar Kahana, a scribal error. Sukkah 52b: Rav Sheshet told him, “Why should I engage Chana in aggadah?” Rashi explains: what have I to do with him in aggadah? He is more expert than I, and I cannot prevail against him. There. He lived in Rav Nachman's time: Bava Kamma 12a. R. Chinena bar Bisna: Beitzah 22a; perhaps they are one person. Berakhot 3b, near the end, has R. Acha bar Bizna, a scribal error. Ein Yaakov has Rav Chana bar Bisna, and the new Talmud editions did not correct it. There, 7a, near the end, Ein Yaakov has Chama bar Bisna. See Huna bar Bizna; perhaps they are one person. Mar Yochanan was his son.
